newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in dull trading today on a lack of market-moving news.
With state-run banks lending out money on the market, some financial institutions including securities houses which traded on the domestic A share market were net borrowers, they said.
A strong upward trend on the A share market in Shanghai will become a positive factor for the interbank market rates in the next few days, in particular for early-maturing contracts, traders said.
